name: Merlin 1D Sea-Level Engine
summary: Gas-generator cycle LOX/RP-1 rocket engine arranged in a 9-engine Octaweb on Stage 1.
function: Provides liftoff thrust (9 engines), boostback & entry braking (3 engines), and terminal hoverslam landing thrust (1–3 engines) with deep-throttling and gimbaled thrust vector control.
materials: Regeneratively cooled copper-alloy combustion chamber with Inconel/superalloy jacket, single-shaft turbopump, and pintle injector.

specs.label: Specific Impulse (SL)
specs.source: Choked-flow consistent with 7607/8227 kN (Block 5 est. 285–288 s)

history: Descended from Merlin 1A/1C on Falcon 1, the Merlin 1D achieved the highest thrust-to-weight ratio (>180:1) of any operational boost engine and is certified for dozens of relights via TEA-TEB pyrophoric ignition.
